stories.title: Aux États-Unis, les raffineurs préviennent Trump : un embargo sur le diesel peut renchérir l’essence

en.title: In the United States, refiners warn Trump: a diesel embargo could raise gasoline prices
en.summary: Over thirty American organizations including refiners and the Chamber of Commerce urged Donald Trump to abandon plans for blocking diesel exports. They argue that restricting foreign sales would reduce refinery production and likely increase fuel costs for consumers, transport companies, and farmers.

stories.title: Aux États-Unis, le retour du crédit immobilier à 7 % politise la dette

en.title: In the United States, mortgage rates returning to 7 percent politicizes debt
en.summary: Average 30-year mortgage rates in the United States reached 7.03 percent on September 24, their highest level since January 2025. This increase linked to long-term financing costs reduces household borrowing capacity and requires developers to offer discounts ahead of midterm elections.
